table.name: forecasting.run_line
table.label: Run line
table.description: One store × subcategory of a month's engine Run under review: the forecast, the AOP, its days and what each basis adds. Loaded in bulk (psql COPY) from the engine's output; people only read it.

columns.label: The forecast for each day (₹, JSON list)
Each basis: its share and value (JSON)

table.name: forecasting.reach
table.label: Reach
table.description: Who reviews what: each person's job, manager and the stores and subcategories they cover, worked out from the org chart and merchandise assignments as Dash's reach is. Loaded in bulk; people only read it.

table.name: forecasting.explanation
table.label: Explanation
table.description: Why a day sold more or less than its forecast: the causes picked and a note, for a store (or every store) and a level of the hierarchy.

table.name: forecasting.forecast_run
table.label: Forecast Run
table.description: One run of Feather Forecast for a month and region; the screens read the official one. Copied from the warehouse as-is (same table and column names); people only read it. Until the warehouse copy table lands (#1418) it is filled by the forecast team or, locally, from made-up fixtures.

columns.label: Run
columns.description: The Feather Forecast run this row belongs to: the official run for the month.

columns.label: Model
columns.description: The forecasting model that made the run.

columns.label: Purpose
columns.description: Official is the run people review; others are trials.

columns.label: Sales Up To
columns.description: The last day of sales the run knew about.

columns.label: Forecast From
columns.description: The first day the run forecasts.

columns.label: Forecast To
columns.description: The last day the run forecasts.

table.name: forecasting.forecast_line_month
table.label: Forecast Line Month
table.description: One line (run × store × subcategory) for the month: Feather Forecast, its six bases and four parts, the growth and the seasonal step. The one table the review screens list from; built by the copy job from the daily forecast and its explanation. Copied from the warehouse as-is (same table and column names); people only read it. Until the warehouse copy table lands (#1418) it is filled by the forecast team or, locally, from made-up fixtures.

columns.label: Run
columns.description: The Feather Forecast run this row belongs to: the official run for the month.

columns.label: Store Code
columns.description: The store, by its SAP code.

columns.label: Section
columns.description: The section of the store the org chart places the subcategory in; its Team Leader reviews it.

columns.label: Feather Forecast (Before Tax)
columns.description: Feather Forecast for the month, in rupees before tax.

columns.label: Feather Forecast Quantity
columns.description: Feather Forecast for the month, in pieces.

columns.label: Same Date Last Year (B1): Own Month
columns.description: What base B1 alone says the month will sell: the same date last year, × the growth. Rupees before tax.

columns.label: Same Festival Day Last Year (B2): Own Month
columns.description: What base B2 alone says the month will sell: the same festival day last year, × the growth. Rupees before tax.

columns.label: Last 28 Days (B3): Own Month
columns.description: What base B3 alone says the month will sell: the last 28 days, as a rate per day × the month's days. Rupees before tax.

columns.label: Last Four Same Weekdays (B4): Own Month
columns.description: What base B4 alone says the month will sell: the last four of the same weekday. Rupees before tax.

columns.label: Same Date Last Month (B5): Own Month
columns.description: What base B5 alone says the month will sell: the same date last month. Rupees before tax.

columns.label: Seasonal Step (B6): Own Month
columns.description: What base B6 alone says the month will sell: the last 28 days × the month's usual seasonal step. Rupees before tax.

columns.label: Same Date Last Year (B1): Adds
columns.description: What base B1 adds to Feather Forecast: its own month × the weight Feather Forecast gives it.

columns.label: Same Festival Day Last Year (B2): Adds
columns.description: What base B2 adds to Feather Forecast: its own month × the weight Feather Forecast gives it.

columns.label: Last 28 Days (B3): Adds
columns.description: What base B3 adds to Feather Forecast: its own month × the weight Feather Forecast gives it.

columns.label: Last Four Same Weekdays (B4): Adds
columns.description: What base B4 adds to Feather Forecast: its own month × the weight Feather Forecast gives it.

columns.label: Same Date Last Month (B5): Adds
columns.description: What base B5 adds to Feather Forecast: its own month × the weight Feather Forecast gives it.

columns.label: Seasonal Step (B6): Adds
columns.description: What base B6 adds to Feather Forecast: its own month × the weight Feather Forecast gives it.

columns.label: Seasonal Step
columns.description: How much more this subcategory usually sells in the month than in the four weeks before it (×).

columns.label: Growth
columns.description: How much faster or slower the subcategory sells now than a year ago (×), applied to last year's sales.

columns.label: From Recent Selling
columns.description: The part of Feather Forecast that comes from what the subcategory sold in the last weeks.

columns.label: Step On Top
columns.description: The seasonal step's extra on top of recent selling.

columns.label: From Last Year × Growth
columns.description: The part of Feather Forecast that comes from last year's sales of the month, × the growth.

columns.label: Adjustments
columns.description: Small tidy-up steps after the blend, such as splitting very small subcategories.

columns.label: Subcategory Code
columns.description: The subcategory's SAP code (material group).

columns.label: Floor
columns.description: The floor of the store the section is on, from the org chart.

columns.label: Floor Order
columns.description: Where the floor comes in the building, bottom first.

columns.label: Suggested Section
columns.description: For a subcategory in no section: the section it most likely belongs to, from its history on the org chart (a Section row id).

columns.label: Why That Section
columns.description: Why that section is suggested, in words.

columns.label: Section Subcategory Rows
columns.description: The org chart's Section Subcategory row ids already used for this subcategory at the store, one a line, so a new row takes a free one.

table.name: forecasting.sales_reference

columns.label: Window
columns.description: Which stretch of sales: last 28 days, the same days last year, last year's month, last 91 days, or the same days last year.

columns.label: Quantity
columns.description: Pieces sold.

columns.label: Forecast (Before Tax)
